gate: A pull at the throat says speak for the group, gather a roomful of separate lives under one direction. This code is the tribal leader's voice, the one that says here is what we have, here is where we are going, here is how we will keep each other fed. It is not a wish to dominate. It is a built-in sense of responsibility for the gathered people, voiced aloud. The misread is to call this bossiness, or to flatten it into mere ambition for status. The drive underneath is older than office. It is the chief at the fire counting the tribe and making sure no one starves. When this code is denied a tribe to speak for, it can curdle into hoarding or into a loud insistence on being heard. Given its proper room, the voice settles into a quiet, certain authority that the people around it want to follow.
centre_field: The throat is the body's loudspeaker, where energy turns into a word that can land in another ear and become a thing in the world. Eleven gates reach for it, more than any other centre. All the energy of the chart is rushing here to be voiced, to be put into a word that can land in another person's ear and become a thing in the world. That placement is the teaching. Leadership in this code is not a private feeling of authority. It is the throat-version of authority, leadership that has to be spoken or it does not exist. The gatherer who never names the gathering has not led anything. The cost of misusing this seat is real and physical. Burned-out voice, burned-out thyroid, the body's way of saying the throat was pushed when it should have rested. The teaching is that the voice is precious cargo and the timing of its use is half the gift.
channel: Leadership at the throat is only one side of the circuit. This code reaches toward the gate of the treasurer, the inward-facing custodian of resources and material control. The two together form the channel of money, the only place in the chart designed for taking charge. The reach matters. Voice without inventory is a rallying speech with nothing in the storehouse to back it. Inventory without voice is a quiet steward whose counsel never reaches the room. Joined, they make the working tribal leader, the one who can name what the group has and direct how it gets spent. Alone, this code is announcement without ledger, a king at the head of the table with no idea what is in the kitchen. The whole design assumes the partner on the other side, the one who has actually counted the grain. Without that ground, the voice loses what gives it the right to lead.
